title: My MallWorld Experience
content: This was last year, I would have a reoccurring dream being in a mall. It had so many floors, I don’t know how many. I only used about 4 of the floors. When I was on the fourth floor it was a bunch of stores, similar to being inside a Macy’s. I would look around and walk around to find clothes and when I would go to try them on the store associate would frighten me and I would go back to the racks and put the clothes away. I would continue that cycle until I would want to leave the store. I would then take the escalator down one level and I would run into my sisters and sometimes additional friends, the friends would change but my sisters were always there. They would tell me they found a secret movie theater and I needed to meet them on the bottom floor. They left me to find it on my own but I was following them. I feel like they moved so quickly compared to me, like I couldn’t chase after them. Eventually when I would go to the ground floor it was packed with tons of people, I got nervous and would try to leave. That’s when my sisters and friends would appear and try to guide me the rest of the way. They would guide me through the crowd of people through two big doors. I got passed the two doors and felt so cold. The lights were dim and flickering like a scary movie and there was spilled blue ink puddles everywhere. They pointed to the movie theater doors and told me to go in there. I looked through the window and saw there was a few dozens of people in there standing around watching a screen. I couldn’t tell what was on display. I remember trying to see the people’s faces and getting terrified after making eye contact with one and running out of there. I still remember frantically running through the crowd in the mall trying to find the exit. I’d always wake up in a panic.
